Definition
[Asymptotic ratios] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0106 1. ch19:19.7a\group Asymptotic Geometry

For a complete noncompact $(N^n,h)$ with $\Rc \ge 0$, set \[ \operatorname {AVR}(h)=\lim _{r\to \infty }\frac{\Vol B(p,r)}{\omega _n r^n}, \qquad \operatorname {ASCR}(h)=\limsup _{d(x,p)\to \infty }R(x)d(x,p)^2. \] Both are independent of $p$.
